name: Agni Sword
aliases: Agni_Sword_US swordsman knight crusader merchant thief
summary: Restore the Swordsman family alongside Merchant and Thief.
description: Allows both Swordsman advancement branches, alongside Merchant and Thief families, through normal and advanced job tiers. The item keeps its existing level requirement, stats and effects.

name: Cocytus Armor
aliases: Cocytus_Armor_US cold bolt storm gust jack frost grade refine armor
summary: Keep the working bonuses, grade effects and +12 autocasts together.
description: Restores refine and grade bonuses. At +12, normal melee attacks can trigger Cold Bolt and Storm Gust (20% each, rolled separately). Grade A adds Cold Bolt → Jack Frost. This switch enables the complete armor repair.
notice: The supplied repair blocks dropping, trading, personal storage and cart by default. The menus below can override trading, storage and cart. Keep original adds no extra permission patch; the active armor repair and other mods still apply.

name: All-in-One Buff Potion
description: Allows trading, personal storage, mail. Turn this repair off to inherit the server’s restrictions after a restart. Other mods, item binding and server rules can still apply.

summary: Restores missing iRO refine tiers, autocasts and Base Level effects on 32 items.
description: Matches the official iRO item descriptions. Future Wolf King Hat: Adds the missing +11, +12 and +13 bonuses and autocasts. Blighted Skullcap: Adds the missing +11, +12, +13 and +15 bonuses, cooldowns and autocasts. Saint Knight Armor: Adds the class skills, +10 Tuna Belly autocast and +13 skill damage. Dark Apostate Armor: Adds the Acolyte-class skills, +10 Tuna Belly autocast and +11 skill damage. Stormy December: Adds the +12, +13 and +14 cooldowns and chain autocasts. November Rain Robe: Adds the +13 and +14 Crystal Rain autocasts. Iron Will: Adds the missing +11, +13 and +14 bonuses. Spin Ball: Adds the +12 and +13 autocasts and fixes the +7 After Cast Delay. Robotic Valkyrie Hairband: Adds the +9, +12 and +13 bonuses and fixes the Merchant-class bonus. Legendary Stone Shield: Adds the per-refine stats and the +12, +13 and +14 bonuses. Thundershell Ward: Adds the Base Level effects and the +12 autocasts. Agni Sword: Adds the Base Level effects and the +12 autocasts. Dark Chaser Boots: Adds the missing +9 and +11 autocasts; +10 now works for ranged attacks too. Starry Sky Twin Prime: Uses iRO refine tiers (+10/+12/+14) and per-refine bonuses. Kshatra Vairya: Moves the refine tiers to iRO's +10/+11/+12/+13. Save the King: Adds MATK +130 and the +11/+12 tiers; heal tiers move to +9/+10. Squirrel Ear Hat: Moves the refine tiers to iRO's +10/+11/+12. Brilliant: Uses iRO tiers (+7/+9/+11) and adds the +12 and +13 bonuses. Mad Linker Glove: Adds the Base Level 99-or-below and 100-or-above effects. Infinity Blade: Uses iRO tiers: Soul Destroyer Lv.5 and no size penalty at +11, ATK +20% at +12. Thorn Armor: Adds Earth property, 30% reflect and the +13 Striking skill and buff. Awakened Old King's Double Edge: Uses iRO tiers: extra skill damage at +11 and +13, penetration and cooldown at +14, capped at Base Lv 240. Vayu Follower Bow: Adds the missing +13, +14 and +15 bonuses. Poison Shoes: Adds per-refine stats, Meteor Assault scaling and +11 bonuses; class bonus only for Acolyte and Thief. Purple Haze: Adds the HP drain, the Reproduce/Weapon Blocking buff, the +10 Poison Burst autocast and the when-hit Venom Swamp. Blood Ruby Dagger: Adds the HP drain and the missing +12 stats and Crimson Rock autocast. Mesarthim: Adds POW/SPL +15 and uses iRO tiers (+9 Ghost, +11 Poison resistance). Royal Morroc Cape: Adds knockback immunity, the +9 and +12 damage and the +14 Dancing Knife autocast. Howling Tiger Pajama: Adds the missing +10 and +12 bonuses. Legendary Performer Manteau: Adds the Voice Lessons bonus and the +11 and +12 bonuses. Boreas Wings: Adds the +10 Frost Diver autocast and the Base Level damage scaling. Novice Follower Suit: Adds the Super/Hyper Novice bonus and the +14 Cart Tornado effects.

toggles.label: Enable iRO effect repairs for all 32 items

notice: Starry Sky Twin Prime, Kshatra Vairya, Save the King, Squirrel Ear Hat, Brilliant, Infinity Blade, Awakened Old King's Double Edge, Mesarthim use iRO's refine levels, which are higher than before, so lower refines get weaker. To turn off one item only, add it under Add items in the in-game Item Repairs editor, choose Remove item, then Save & Export.
